item.title: [汽车] 特斯拉柏林工程中心启用
item.author: @Teslarati
item.description:
特斯拉在柏林Köpenick开设第三个工程中心（继弗里蒙特、上海之后），30个实验室、投资约1亿欧元、首批250余名工程师，将加强与柏林工厂的协同。

@Teslarati · 赞 40 · 转 5 · 浏览 7180

Tesla has opened its Berlin Engineering Center in Köpenick, its third hub after Fremont and Shanghai. Four sites become one campus with 30 labs, about €100M invested and 250+ engineers to start. A tighter loop between Berlin's engineers and Giga Berlin's lines should help.
